# Pallier, Lexique. The g2p engine (g2p.ts) handles OOV words.
# ⚠ ADDITIONS BELOW THE LEXIQUE SET are listed here so the provenance line above stays true. Each is
#   a word Lexique does not carry, with the evidence that justified it.
#   kanjar  kɑ̃dʒaʁ->kandʒaʁ : a South Asian surname. The g2p nasalises ⟨an⟩ by French rule (kɑ̃ʒˈaʁ);
#   FLEURS readers say kandʒaʁ — un-nasalised AND ⟨j⟩ as /dʒ/ rather than /ʒ/. Both takes of the one
#   sentence that contains it improve against both recognizers (0.219->0.162, 0.179->0.113).
#   ⚠ THE ENTRY IS THE NAME, NOT A RULE: one surname in one sentence does not establish that French
#   should stop nasalising foreign ⟨an⟩ generally. That broader question is logged, not assumed.
